# quicknode_kv_list_items (Resource)

Items in a Quicknode Key-Value Store list. Terraform manages only these items and leaves the rest of the list alone, for lists that Streams filters or other tools also write to. Adding items to a missing list creates it.

Create fails if any of the items are already in the list, so destroy never removes items Terraform didn't add. To take over existing items, import the resource and apply. Don't use it with a `quicknode_kv_list` for the same key, since that resource removes items it doesn't know about.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A list that a Streams filter also adds to. Terraform tracks only these items
# and leaves the filter's items in place.
resource "quicknode_kv_list_items" "treasury" {
  list_key = "tracked-wallets"
  items = [
    "0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045",
    "0x71C7656EC7ab88b098defB751B7401B5f6d8976F",
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `items` (Set of String) Items this resource adds to the list. Items are case-sensitive, so `0xABC` and `0xabc` are different items. Changes are sent as additions and removals, up to 1500 items per request. Items removed outside Terraform are added back on the next apply.
- `list_key` (String) Name of the list the items belong to. Up to 255 letters, digits, spaces and `.` `:` `_` `-` `$`. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `list_key`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by list key to take over items already in the list. The import starts
# with no items; the next apply takes over the configured ones and leaves the
# rest alone.
terraform import quicknode_kv_list_items.treasury tracked-wallets
```
